policies.title: Fijian ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Fiji Islands as Prior to Arrival, which it defines as obtaining a visa from a mission or consulate before travel.
conditions: Applies to a Fijian ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a mission or consulate before travel.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Fijian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Fijian visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to a Fijian ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Fijian ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule lists Fiji in its No Visa Required cohort.
conditions: Applies to a Fijian ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Fijian ordinary passports: Türkiye electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's Foreign Ministry says ordinary Fijian passport holders may obtain a one-month single-entry e-Visa, and its official e-Visa service describes online issuance before travel.
conditions: Applies to a Fijian ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The Foreign Ministry specifies a one-month, single-entry e-Visa; it also describes a separate 90-day multiple-entry mission-visa route.
Apply and pay online, then download the e-Visa sent by email before travel. Work, residence and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Türkiye e-Visa application
steps: Start an application with the Fijian ordinary passport and travel details.
Enter the required information and pay through the official e-Visa service.
Download the e-Visa sent by email before travel.
